content: Semantics of RapidPrototypingScenario A RapidPro- totypingScenario aggregates one or more RptContainer s and one or more RptProfile s: • Each RptContainer instance specifies, by reference, one or more element(s) applicable to the service-based access. • Each RptProfile instance specifies both the name of the RP Service Function (attributes servicePointSymbolPre and servicePointSym- bolPost ) and the applicable RP Service Point ID s (attributes minServi- cePointId and maxServicePointId ).
